production_method_description: Physical modeling of plucked strings. Uses delay line feedback loop with low-pass filter (moving average) to simulate acoustic decay.

synthesis_parameters.excitation: 2-sample uniform noise burst scaled by MIDI velocity (pick transient)
synthesis_parameters.delay_line: N = round(sr / f0), full cycle period (single-delay loop, no sign inversion)
synthesis_parameters.loop_gain: 0.996 base with spectral tilt 0.994..0.997 (brighter strings ring longer)
synthesis_parameters.pan: static per voice (lead width 0.55); lead voice drifts -0.55..+0.55 across the 8 chorale cells
synthesis_parameters.bus: soft-knee saturation (thresh 0.82, slope 0.32), peak normalize -1 dBFS

render_engine: pure numpy Karplus-Strong physical modeling (methods_db.md SP-011)
